NONE: › an informal way of writing the word god, when used in expressions of fear, surprise, etc.
（用於表示害怕、吃驚等）上帝，老天爺，天哪

example: 「上帝啊，幫幫我們吧，」她大叫了起來。
Oh gawd! You don't believe that do you?
喲，老天爺！你不信是不是？

NONE: › to look at something or someone in a stupid or rude way
呆頭呆腦地看；無禮地瞪眼看

example: Don't sit there gawking like that - give me a hand!
別坐在那裡傻看啊——幫我一把！
They just stood there gawking at me.
他們就站在那裡呆呆地盯著我看。
一個笨手笨腳的高個子少年
